areas_completed: WCAG AA Contrast & Focus Ring System

decisions.toggle_placement: Directly on the VerdictHero card right above or beside the Today/Tomorrow tabs for immediate context.
decisions.toggle_control: Segmented button control ('Standard' | 'Sensitive group') with subtle active pill styling matching Today/Tomorrow.
decisions.toggle_persistence: Device-local localStorage key `breeze:profile` ('standard' | 'sensitive'), defaulting to 'standard' if unset, read synchronously on mount.
decisions.toggle_explanation: Subtle explanatory caption directly under the toggle ('Lower thresholds for asthma, elderly, children & respiratory sensitivity') linked via aria-describedby.
decisions.stale_cache_ui: Warm amber pill badge 'Cached Xm ago' directly on the reading card, with an explicit tooltip/subtext stating that upstream live data timed out and cached values are being used.
decisions.total_failure_ui: Dedicated ErrorCard with 'Can't assess right now — live upstream air data is temporarily unavailable', a prominent Retry button, and zero numbers or synthetic verdicts displayed.
decisions.station_only_degrade: Show Today verdict & reading cleanly from the station; hide ForecastChart, BestWindow chip, and Tomorrow tab, with an inline note: 'Forecast model temporarily unavailable'.
decisions.model_only_degrade: Render complete experience (Today, Tomorrow, 48h chart, best window, tips) labelled honestly as 'Regional model estimate (~45 km)' with Low confidence chip.
decisions.verdict_aria_announcement: aria-live='polite' region on verdict card announcing upon load and tab switch: '[Today/Tomorrow]: [Verdict], PM2.5 [X] µg/m³, [Category], [Top reason]'.
decisions.profile_toggle_announcement: Trigger polite aria-live update: 'Profile updated to Sensitive group. Recalculated verdict: [New Verdict]'.
decisions.chart_scrub_announcement: Debounced (100–150ms) polite live announcement on Arrow key scrub: '[Day] [Hour]: [PM2.5] µg/m³, [Category]'.
decisions.aria_region_dom_placement: Dedicated visually-hidden (<span className='sr-only' aria-live='polite' aria-atomic='true'>) region at the top of the main container for routing/status notifications.
decisions.contrast_audit: Audit every text/bg combination against 4.5:1 (normal text) and 3:1 (large text/ui components), darkening text hues (e.g. amber-950, emerald-950, rose-950) with soft tinted backgrounds.
decisions.focus_ring_system: Standardized high-contrast focus ring: `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2` across all interactive elements.
decisions.reduced_motion: Explicit CSS `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rules that disable pulsing animations on Skeletons and instant-jump SVG tooltip and tab transitions.
decisions.non_color_signals: Triad pattern everywhere: Every category display features Category Name (Text) + Numerical PM2.5 + Distinct Icon (Checkmark / Alert / Hazard) alongside color.
